ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a contour topographic map, with place H on the left side and settlement Jia on the right side; the scale below the figure marks 0 to 20 km. Visually estimating according to the scale, the horizontal distance from place H to settlement Jia is about two scale lengths, that is, about 40 km. The contour labels visible in the figure include 1000 m, 1600 m, etc.; combined with the contour distribution, it is estimated that the position where place H is located is about 1200 m higher than settlement Jia. Then reason: the question stem states that the center of the high-pressure weather system exactly coincides with place H at 10 a.m. and moves eastward at a speed of about 200 km per day. From 10:00 to 15:00, 5 hours pass, and the distance the high-pressure center moves eastward is about 200×5/24≈41.7 km, close to the about 40 km distance from H to Jia on the map, so at 15:00 settlement Jia is roughly controlled by the high-pressure-center air that was originally at place H. This air moving from H to Jia is equivalent to descending about 1200 m in elevation. Calculating according to dry adiabatic warming during descent of about 1℃/100 m, the warming is about 12℃. At 10 a.m., the temperature at place H was 12℃, so when it reaches near Jia at 15:00, the temperature is about 12℃+12℃=24℃.
